findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:994-1002,1137-1169 — one 2-line centred UILabel, systemFontOfSize:15, theme secondary colour, text "No chats yet.\nTap the pencil to start one.", placed inside the tableView 40pt above centre.
findings.theirs: A 250pt-wide container centred in self.view (inserted BELOW the table) holding NoMessages.png, then a bold 15pt title #8b97a5 "You have no conversations yet", then a wrapped system 14pt #8b97a5 body "Start messaging by pressing the pencil button in the top right corner or go to the Contacts section." (icon → +21pt → title → +8pt → body, body constrained to 232pt).
findings.fix: Replace emptyLabel with a 250pt container inserted below the table view: icon view (NoMessages.png — art not in images/, needs adding), title UILabel boldSystemFontOfSize:15 colour rgb(0x8b,0x97,0xa5) text "You have no conversations yet" at y = iconBottom+21, body UILabel systemFontOfSize:14 same colour, numberOfLines 0, sized to fit 232pt wide, at titleBottom+8; container centred at floorf((view.width-250)/2), floorf((view.height-containerHeight)/2).

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:924-926,1903-1944 — left bar button titled "Edit" opens a TGActionsMenu popup (Select list / Add story / Mark all read / Edit folders).
findings.theirs: Left button "Edit" (Common.Edit) puts the table into editing mode: each cell slides in a 30x30 ListEditingSwitch minus button at x 4, y (int)((73-30)/2)=21, and the button itself is replaced by a Done button (Common.Done, TGToolbarButtonTypeDone, minWidth 51, padding 10/10). Compose button fades to alpha 0 while editing.
findings.fix: Make the left button toggle self.tableView editing and swap the title to "Done" while editing, hiding the compose button (alpha 0) meanwhile; move the folder/mark-read menu somewhere that is not the Edit slot.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:2645-2646 — cellForRow overwrites the cell's own colours with theme values: primaryTextColour = rgb(0x22,0x22,0x22) (TGTheme.m:223) for the title and secondaryTextColour = rgb(0x8D,0x8E,0x90) (TGTheme.m:224) for the preview.
findings.fix: For the default (non-imported, light) theme make primaryTextColour rgb(0x11,0x11,0x11) and the chat-list preview colour rgb(0x88,0x88,0x88), or stop overriding the cell's own 0x111111/0x888888 in cellForRowAtIndexPath for that theme. Note the cell's init already has 0x111111/0x888888 (lines 135, 142) — the override is what breaks it.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:2699 uses [theme typingColour] = TG_BLUE_BLURPLE3 rgb(0x70,0xAA,0xEA) (TGTheme.m:230,402) for the typing/action line.
findings.theirs: Action / media preview text is #536c8c (a desaturated slate blue, not a light blue).
findings.fix: Set typingColour (light theme) to rgb(0x53,0x6c,0x8c); use the same colour for media-kind previews (photo/video/etc.), which the original also draws in 0x536c8c rather than grey.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:2711-2713 — a single tick, always DialogListSent.png, for any outgoing chat; no read state, no pending state.
findings.theirs: Two distinct images: DialogListSent.png (13x11) at dateX-15 for delivered, DialogListRead.png (18x11, double tick) at dateX-20 for read, plus a 12x12 pending indicator at dateX-16 for unsent. images/ already contains DialogListSent@2x.png, DialogListRead@2x.png and their _Highlighted variants — DialogListRead is sitting unused.
findings.fix: Add a second image view for the read tick: DialogListRead at CGRectMake(dateX - 20, 11 + retinaPixel, 18, 11) when the last outgoing message is read, DialogListSent at CGRectMake(dateX - 15, 11 + retinaPixel, 13, 11) when only delivered.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:61-72 computes TGDialogListBadgeImage(YES) from DialogListUnreadBadge_Highlighted.png but never assigns it; badge label has no highlightedTextColor, and the arrow (line 206) has no highlighted image. On tap the row plate inverts to blue while badge and arrow keep their normal art.
findings.theirs: Every right-hand element carries a highlighted counterpart: unread badge uses initWithImage:…highlightedImage:…, its label switches text to #2371c2 with a clear shadow (from white text + #8091a6 shadow), and the arrow is initWithImage:arrowImage() highlightedImage:arrowHighlightedImage(). The title/preview/date text is also redrawn in white while highlighted.
findings.citation: TGDialogListCell.m:409-424 (badge + label highlighted colours), :429-431 (arrowView highlighted image), :195,:229-236 (white text when highlighted)
findings.fix: Use initWithImage:highlightedImage: for badgeBackground (DialogListUnreadBadge / _Highlighted) and arrow (DialogListArrow / DialogListArrow_Highlighted), set badge.highlightedTextColor = rgb(0x23,0x71,0xc2) with shadowColor clear when highlighted, and set highlightedTextColor = white on titleLabel, previewLabel and dateLabel.

findings.ours: The group-chat row shows only the message text — there is no author line (src/TGChatListViewController.m:2694-2708 has no authorName branch, and TGChatCell has no author label).
findings.theirs: In a group chat the sender's name is drawn on its own frame CGRectMake(73, 29, width - 73 - 10 - rightPadding, 20) in bold system 14, colour #345f8f, and the message rect is pushed down by 9 (and shortened by 12) to sit beneath it.
findings.citation: TGDialogListCell.m:196 (authorNameColor = UIColorRGB(0x345f8f)), :372 (authorNameFont = boldSystemFontOfSize:14), :1355-1361 (author frame and message offset)
findings.fix: Add an author UILabel: boldSystemFontOfSize:14, rgb(0x34,0x5f,0x8f), frame (73, 29, w-73-10-rightPadding, 20) for group chats; when it is shown move previewLabel to y 38 and reduce its height by 12.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:1154-1163 invents "No results", "Connecting…", "No archived chats", "No chats in this folder", "No chats yet.\nTap the pencil to start one."
findings.theirs: The dialog list has exactly one empty string pair: "You have no conversations yet" / "Start messaging by pressing the pencil button in the top right corner or go to the Contacts section." Connection state is not an empty-list message at all — it goes in the navigation title, next to a spinner (titleStateUpdated:isLoading:).
findings.citation: Localizable.strings "DialogList.NoMessagesTitle"/"DialogList.NoMessagesText"; TGDialogListController.mm:262-268, 340-347 (_titleStatusLabel + _titleStatusIndicator in the title view)
findings.fix: Use the two original strings for the main empty state, and show connection state as a title-view label plus a UIActivityIndicatorView 5pt to its left (label centred with the indicator width+5 accounted for, y offset -1), which is where the original puts "Connecting…".

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:33 kSwipeEdgeDistance = 10.0f; buttons collapse to x = width - 10 - 2 and expand right-edge at width - 10.
findings.theirs: static const float edgeDistance = 6; the delete button collapses to CGRectMake(width - 6 - 2, y, 2, 31) and expands to CGRectMake(width - 6 - 61, y, 61, 31), i.e. 6pt from the right edge, and its y is a literal 20 (not the centred 21).
findings.fix: Change kSwipeEdgeDistance to 6 and the swipe-button top to 20 (matching _editingButton.frame y) instead of (int)((73-31)/2).

findings.ours: Every row is drawn on the same white plate; unread rows differ only by the badge (src/TGChatListViewController.m:2642-2644, 2718-2730).
findings.theirs: The cell keeps a distinct unread palette: background #ebf0f5 and message text #5b646e for an unread conversation versus white / #888888 for a read one.
findings.fix: When unread > 0, tint the cell plate rgb(0xeb,0xf0,0xf5) and draw the preview text in rgb(0x5b,0x64,0x6e); keep white / 0x888888 otherwise.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:156-159 — one plain UILabel, systemFontOfSize:13, right-aligned, for the whole date string.
findings.theirs: TGDateLabel with a three-font scale: dateFont system 13, dateTextFont bold system 13 (for the day word, e.g. "Mon"), dateLabelFont system 11 (for the AM/PM suffix, amWidth/pmWidth 19, dstOffset 2), drawn left-aligned inside a fixed 75x15 frame.
findings.citation: TGDialogListCell.m:388-397 (dateLabel font scale and widths), :1309 (dateFrame 75x15 at y 9)
findings.fix: Render the date in parts: bold system 13 for a weekday/date token, system 13 for the time digits, system 11 for the AM/PM suffix laid out in a 19pt slot — or at minimum use bold system 13 when the date collapses to a weekday, which is the visible half of the difference.

findings.ours: src/TGChatListViewController.m:1662-1666 — tapping the search bar refuses to begin editing and pushes a separate TGSearchViewController.
findings.theirs: The search bar is the table header and searching happens in place through TGSearchDisplayMixin, with a scope bar ("Conversations" / "Messages") drawn with SearchBarScopeButton art; result rows are 51pt for conversations and 73pt for messages.
findings.citation: TGDialogListController.mm:499-536 (searchBar as tableHeaderView, scope titles), :1129 (51 / 73 search row heights)
findings.fix: If in-place search is not being restored, at least keep the two scopes and the 51/73 row heights in the pushed search page so the results look like the original's; the placeholder string "Search" (DialogList.SearchLabel) is already correct.
